title: Crew of Wellington W5444
memorial_details: Large, square tablet mounted horizontally on a low brick plinth. The memorial appears to have a thin, white composite board attached to a concrete slab. The dedication is printed in black, upper and lower-case letters. An illustrated information board is positioned behind the memorial and a flagpole to the left flies a Union Jack. Another memorial to this crew is located at All Saint's Church in the same village (ref 19954)
inscription: WELLINGTON BOMBER/ CRASHED 17TH AUGUST 1941/ (name)/ PILOT/ (name)/ NAVIGATOR/ (name)/ AIR GUNNER An information board behind the memorial gives details of the crash and names of the surviving crew members.
